text:
joel: Quick async check — rolled canary slice3 to v2.3 at 00:15 UTC (night window). Seeing a small spike in 5xxs and p95 latency lift between 00:18-00:22. Metrics + logs below, will keep it to 3% unless we see sustained degradation. thoughts?

ops-bot: ALERT automated: route=/generate 5xx_rate=0.6% threshold=0.5% triggered=00:19 UTC. link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/2987 (incid id: #CANARY-2987)

maya: I pulled the request logs — a cluster of S3 upload timeouts around 00:19, a few retries surfaced. p99 of storage write jumped which lines up with p95 latency bump. investigating external dep.

tim: Checked canary host health — no OOMs, CPU stable. kube events around the time show several transient connector errors to storage. no pod restarts. which quant profile is this using?

joel: This slice used profile: q4_0 + adaptive batcher + kv_cache enabled. Rollout flags (snippet):
```
feature_flags: {
  infer_v2_canary: true,
  infer_v2_slice3_pct: 3,
  infer_v2_fallback_pct: 0
}
```

anita: If storage is the root cause I'd rather keep at 3% and watch for 15m. Recommend adding a temporary fallback route that sends failed /generate to v2.2 (stable) at 1% of failing traffic. I can flip the flag if you give the go. @joel :+1:

sarah: I have a small PR that reduces batcher timeout from 80ms -> 40ms which should reduce tail latency when storage stalls — link: https://git.redwood/p/infer/PR-452. Can do hotfix today if we want to try.

tim: :thumbsup: I prefer the fallback + hotfix. If PR lands, watch CPU since smaller timeouts can increase QPS. Ops-bot — please monitor autoscale and p95 for the canary pods.

ops-bot: SCHEDULED check: autoscale policy 'canary-burst' observed +1 replica at 00:20 due to latency pace. Will report if CPU > 85% for 5m.

joel: Plan: hold at 3% for another 15m, enable fallback 1% to v2.2 if errors persist >1% for 10m, and merge Sarah's PR as hotfix if we still see p95 > target. I'll toggle the alert thresholds (raise maintenance window) and update here. Thanks all.

maya: copying logs to the incident folder: /incidents/canary-2991234567/logs.tar.gz. I'll keep watching external storage retries and open a ticket with infra if we see repeats.

anita: I'll prepare the rollout fudge flag and stand by to flip. ping me when you want the fallback enabled.

joel: update 00:45 UTC — p95 back near baseline, 5xx now 0.12%. Keeping slice at 3%, not enabling fallback. Closing watch window but will reopen if spike recurs.

sarah: thanks — will still land the batching PR to reduce future tail risk; assigning follow-up.

joel: thanks team, filing post-check notes and follow-ups in the launch board.
